## Self-review (no approval required - this checklist is the content gate)

Walk the preview deployment, not localhost.

- [ ] Build check green
- [ ] Copy matches the brief - no lorem, no placeholder, no TODO visible
- [ ] Every number, price and date traces to a real source - nothing invented
- [ ] Brand: current tokens, "10Fold" numeral-1-0-capital-F no space, no emojis
- [ ] Every link and CTA goes where it says
- [ ] Forms: submitted a real test entry, it landed, error state works
- [ ] Checked at phone width
- [ ] Title, description, favicon, social share image correct
- [ ] robots.txt / sitemap allow indexing
- [ ] No console errors
- [ ] No key, token or internal URL in page source
- [ ] SITE.md updated if anything it describes changed
